function_v0.doc: Bumps instance TTL. Anyone can call this to keep the contract alive.
function_v0.name: extend_ttl

function_v0.doc: Returns the full MarketConfig for a given market_id.
function_v0.name: get_market

function_v0.doc:
Called once at deployment.

insurance_market_wasm_hash: the WASM hash returned by `stellar contract upload`
for the insurance-market contract. Factory uses this to deploy fresh instances.
function_v0.name: initialize

function_v0.doc: Returns all market IDs that have been created.
function_v0.name: list_markets

function_v0.doc:
Creates a new insurance market by deploying a fresh insurance-market contract
instance and initializing it with the provided parameters.

Only the factory admin can call this.
Returns the new market_id (increments monotonically from 0).

Deployment uses a deterministic salt based on market_id, so each
market has a predictable contract address.
function_v0.name: create_market

function_v0.doc: Allows admin to remove a market from the factory registry.
function_v0.name: delete_market

function_v0.doc: Allows admin to update the WASM hash (e.g., for contract upgrades).\nAll subsequent markets will use the new WASM. Existing markets are unaffected.
function_v0.name: update_wasm_hash

function_v0.doc: Returns just the contract address for a given market_id.
function_v0.name: get_market_contract

void_v0.doc: Address \xe2\x80\x94 factory admin (only they can create markets)
void_v0.name: Admin

void_v0.doc: u32 \xe2\x80\x94 next market ID to assign
void_v0.name: NextMarketId

void_v0.doc: BytesN<32> \xe2\x80\x94 WASM hash of the insurance-market contract\nStored after `stellar contract upload`, used by factory to deploy instances
void_v0.name: InsuranceMarketHash

void_v0.doc: Address \xe2\x80\x94 the single shared anchor-stake contract
void_v0.name: AnchorStakeContract

udt_struct_v0.doc: Full configuration for one market instance.\nStored in the factory and also passed to the insurance-market on initialization.
udt_struct_v0.name: MarketConfig

fields.doc: Some(address) for anchor-specific markets; None for generic stablecoin markets
fields.name: anchor_id

fields.doc: How long the price must stay below threshold before settlement triggers (seconds)
fields.name: breach_duration_seconds

fields.doc: SAC address of the collateral token (USDC, EURC, etc.)
fields.name: collateral_token

fields.doc: SEP-40 oracle asset: Asset::Other(Symbol) for USDC/EURC etc.
fields.name: covered_asset

fields.doc: Price below which a depeg is detected, 14-decimal fixed point\n$0.995 = 9_950_000_000_000_0 (i.e. 0.995 * 1e14)
fields.name: depeg_threshold

fields.doc: Unix timestamp when market expires and NO winners can claim
fields.name: expiry_timestamp

fields.doc: Address of the deployed insurance-market contract for this market\n(populated after create_market runs)
fields.name: market_contract

udt_union_v0.doc:
SEP-40 oracle standard interface.

Price is 14-decimal fixed point: 100_000_000_000_000 = $1.00
Timestamp is Unix seconds (u64).
udt_union_v0.name: Asset
